item.title: The New High-Capacity 1911 DS Warrior – From Kimber
item.description: Many moons ago, I happened upon the first release of the Kimber Warrior. It was love at first sight, and I had to have it. item.description: Pocket carry has always been a balancing act. item.title: Shoulder Transition with Rifle – Shooting Fundamentals
item.description: If you have ever spent any serious time training with your rifle, you have undoubtedly run into a barricade or corner on your offside. These can be challenging because our ultimate goal is to minimize our exposure at any edge. Leaning out and making the shot is an option, but it comes at the cost of major body exposure. item.title: Dead Air RXD910Ti –New Suppressor in the RXD Series
item.description: There are few items as nice to have on your gun as a suppressor. The ability to shoot with reduced sound makes range time much more enjoyable. Add to that the improvement in felt recoil and muzzle rise, and suppressors are a winner. The nature of suppressors also allows them to work in multiple calibers.
